decision.explanation: The question asks for the population of Croydon Park. Multiple distinct population figures are provided across the original sources, each tied to specific census years or timeframes. The 2016 census reports 11,012 (D1S7, D3S1), the 2021 census reports 10,929 (D2S5), and the 2011 census reports 3,998 (D4S2, D5S1). These are separate valid answers because they refer to different points in time and are explicitly stated in the sources. There is no evidence of conflicting claims about the same referent at the same time, so all three values are preserved.
